## Changes

### Added
- Local comics: import CBZ or ZIP files, and on Android and desktop folders of images, from More → Import comics. They are copied into Yoru, added to your bookmarks and read offline, from the new Local source. Name files like `Series - Ch. 12.cbz` (or `Vol. 3`), or put a `ComicInfo.xml` in the CBZ, so the chapters of a series group together.
- A local comic's menu has Add chapters (the files go into that comic, whatever their names), Edit details (title, author, synopsis, genres and cover) and Delete from device. Local comics stay on the device: Google Drive sync leaves them out.
- Give support: a Ko-fi link in More → About the app.

### Changed
- Yoru no longer comes with sources installed. The sources you have stay; on a new install, add them from More → Extensions, where the default repo is already listed.

### Fixed
- Some covers (and chapter pages) in AVIF format, such as VoraToon's cover for My Dragon Girlfriend Has Returned, stayed blank on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android 11 or older. Yoru now converts them so they show on every device.
- The Android APKs of 2.23.2 could not be built, so that version was never released; 2.24.0 includes its fix above.
